_about: A transcript of what is PRINTED on the fixture pages, verified against the
document itself. This is the ground truth the extractor is scored against.
It is deliberately not produced by the extractor. The codes were taken by a
plain regex over the PDF's own text layer, and the rows by grouping those
codes on their exact printed baselines - both simpler and independent of the
tolerance-based clustering being measured. Scoring the extractor against its
own output would let it misread the flyer completely and still score 100%.
`sha256` pins the fixture. If the PDF changes, the golden must be
re-verified against the new one rather than silently re-blessed.

pages._note: The cover. Codes but no priced grid, and the page most likely to break an extractor tuned on the dense spreads.
pages.heading: Inspiring Designs, Exciting Promotions
_row_note: SRTBF11102 and SRTWT51012 are set 6pt apart and read as one row.
FG-CW13 and FG-CW06 are 45pt apart and are two.
SRT764-25 is printed as 'SRT764-25 -CR', with a space inside the SKU,
so it is in `codes` but sits in no row this transcript can place.
